_schema._general: A small reusable catalog for 'pick a weapon type' grants — currently only Wizard Bladesinger's Training in War and Song ('proficiency with one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice') uses it, but built as its own file/module (matching this session's metamagic.json/maneuvers.json convention) since a future feat or subclass could plausibly need the same list. Names are stored lowercase, matching this app's existing weapon_proficiencies convention exactly (see any real character's weapon_proficiencies array, e.g. Denna's ['simple', 'hand crossbow', 'longsword', 'rapier', 'shortsword']) — pushed directly into that field with no case conversion.
_schema.one_handed_melee: Every real PHB Simple/Martial melee weapon usable one-handed (versatile weapons included — they CAN be used one-handed even if a bigger die is available two-handed). Excludes: every two-handed-ONLY weapon (greatclub, glaive, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, maul, pike), every ranged weapon, and every purely thrown-only weapon that isn't also a real melee weapon.
